The game appeared to be slipping away from the hosts, but the second-half changes eventually began to pay dividends for the home side. A Grandstand Finish Hope was restored for the home fans in the 78th minute when Nicolas Gaitan found the target to pull a goal back. The strike galvanized Aldosivi , turning the final stages into a nervous battle of attrition. Gimnasia LP were forced to defend deep, picking up several cautions as Pedro Silva Torrejon and Mateo Seoane went into the book. Despite a frantic final push from the hosts during six minutes of stoppage time, the visitors held firm to secure a hard-fought victory on the road.
